- Trimmed options, if wanted: `--drop-b10` (licensing options from day 20 only) gives 2,480 chains, about 4.8–5.1 h; 15 seeds (`--seeds 250-264`) gives 2,760 chains, about 5.4–5.7 h. Either must be decided before launch.
